program.name: ESC ECU (Electronic Stability Control) - Brake System
program.fmea_team: John Doe (Mfg Eng), Jane Smith (Quality), Bob Johnson (Manufacturing), Mike Chen (Test)

process_flow.equipment: Visual inspection station, X-ray (sample), dimension gage
process_flow.key_characteristics: Trace continuity, pad cleanliness, board dimensions
process_flow.key_parameters: Visual per IPC-A-610 Class A; no cracks > 0.1mm

process_flow.equipment: Pick-and-place machine (Fuji CP842) with vision guidance

process_flow.key_parameters: 100% coverage, placement accuracy 100% pass rate target

process_flow.equipment: Solder paste printer (Ersa Smartflow), stencil cleaner
process_flow.key_characteristics: Paste volume, paste coverage, edge definition
process_flow.key_parameters: Paste per IPC J-STD-005, stencil aperture ±25% per IPC-7525

process_flow.equipment: Convection reflow oven (Vitronics Sentry) with thermal profiler
process_flow.key_characteristics: Solder joint wetting, intermetallic formation, thermal stress
process_flow.key_parameters: Peak temp 245-260°C, dwell 60-120 sec, ramp 1-3°C/sec, IPC J-STD-001 Class A

process_flow.key_characteristics: Solder joint quality, bridges, opens, voids, component presence
process_flow.key_parameters: 100% coverage, Grade A per IPC J-STD-001, void max 25%

process_flow.equipment: X-ray inspection system (Viscom X7056) with image processing
process_flow.key_characteristics: BGA solder joint quality, internal voids, ball interconnect
process_flow.key_parameters: Void acceptance ≤25% per IPC-A-610 Class A; AQL 1.0 sampling or 100%

process_flow.equipment: ICT bed-of-nails tester (Teradyne Magnum, custom fixture)
process_flow.key_characteristics: Electrical continuity, shorts, parametric values, component functionality
process_flow.key_parameters: Test coverage >95%, digital pass/fail, parametric limits per spec

process_flow.equipment: Spray booth with temperature/humidity monitor, conformal coat (acrylic or silicone)
process_flow.key_characteristics: Coating thickness, coverage uniformity, avoided areas (connectors, test pads)
process_flow.key_parameters: Coating 25-100 μm per material, coverage ≥95%, masks per design

process_flow.equipment: Assembly fixturing, torque tools, connector insertion tools
process_flow.key_characteristics: Fastener torque, connector seating, mechanical alignment
process_flow.key_parameters: Torque 0.5-0.8 Nm (M3), connector fully seated, alignment ±0.5mm

process_flow.equipment: FCT bench with real-time simulator, firmware programmer (JTAG interface)
process_flow.key_characteristics: Power stability, sensor response, actuator control, communication, firmware version
process_flow.key_parameters: Supply 4.5-5.5V, sensor stimulus within spec, firmware checksum verified

process_flow.equipment: Label printer, barcode scanner, QA audit station, packaging station
process_flow.key_characteristics: Label legibility, serial number accuracy, barcode scanability, BOM match, documentation
process_flow.key_parameters: Barcode scannable, serial unique, BOM 100% match, no defects per IPC-A-610

process_functions.function: Verify PCB integrity and assembly readiness
process_functions.requirement: No trace cracks, pad cleanliness Class A per IPC-A-610, no foreign material
process_functions.characteristic: PCB trace continuity, pad cleanliness, dimensions

process_functions.function: Place all SMT components in correct position and orientation
process_functions.requirement: IPC-A-610 Class A placement accuracy (±0.1mm X/Y, ±0.5° rotation)

process_functions.function: Detect placement defects before reflow to prevent downstream issues
process_functions.requirement: 100% optical coverage of components, orientation, alignment

process_functions.function: Apply precise amount of solder paste to facilitate joint formation
process_functions.requirement: Solder paste per IPC J-STD-005; paste volume tolerance ±25%

process_functions.function: Melt solder paste and form reliable electrical and mechanical solder joints
process_functions.requirement: Thermal profile per IPC J-STD-001 Class A; solder joint wetting > 75%
process_functions.characteristic: Solder joint quality, intermetallic formation, thermal stress

process_functions.function: Detect solder defects (cold joints, bridges, voids) before test
process_functions.requirement: 100% optical coverage, Grade A solder quality per IPC J-STD-001

process_functions.function: Verify internal solder joint quality and interconnect integrity (BGA)
process_functions.requirement: Void content ≤25% per IPC-A-610 Class A, no internal cracks
process_functions.characteristic: BGA solder ball quality, void content

process_functions.function: Verify electrical continuity, shorts, and parametric function before integration test
process_functions.requirement: Test coverage >95%, digital pass/fail, parametric limits per schematic

process_functions.function: Protect PCB assembly from moisture and corrosion during field operation
process_functions.requirement: Conformal coating 25-100 μm, coverage ≥95%, no coating on connectors/test pads

process_functions.function: Integrate PCB sub-assembly with mechanical components and connectors
process_functions.requirement: Fastener torque per spec, connectors fully seated, no mechanical damage
process_functions.characteristic: Mechanical integrity, connector seating, fastener torque

process_functions.function: Verify end-to-end system functionality, load calibration and firmware
process_functions.requirement: All safety functions operational, communication verified, firmware version correct
process_functions.characteristic: System functionality, power stability, firmware integrity

process_functions.function: Ensure traceability, quality compliance, and safe shipment to customer
process_functions.requirement: Serial number unique, BOM match verified, no defects per audit standard
process_functions.characteristic: Serial number accuracy, BOM compliance, labeling and documentation

failure_modes.process_function: Place all SMT components in correct position and orientation
failure_modes.failure_effect_next_op: Solder joint will form but pins internally shorted; component may be damaged during reflow
failure_modes.failure_effect_end_user: Device will not boot; complete system failure; warranty return
failure_modes.failure_cause: Pick-and-place machine calibration lost; operator misalignment; feeder tape rotated wrong
failure_modes.prevention_control: Daily machine calibration checklist; machine vision verification of component orientation; feeder orientation labeled
failure_modes.detection_control: AOI (Automated Optical Inspection) 100% orientation check before reflow
failure_modes.recommended_action: Implement mandatory daily offset verification + vision system confidence monitoring

failure_modes.process_function: Melt solder paste and form reliable electrical and mechanical solder joints
failure_modes.failure_effect_next_op: Joint may fail during mechanical shock test or vibration; high electrical resistance risk
failure_modes.failure_effect_end_user: Intermittent electrical failures in field; difficult to diagnose; warranty return likely
failure_modes.failure_cause: Reflow oven temperature profile out of spec; solder paste shelf-life exceeded; component lead oxidation
failure_modes.prevention_control: Reflow profile monitoring (real-time SPC); paste shelf-life control (date codes); lead finish specification
failure_modes.detection_control: X-ray inspection (AQL 1.0 sample) + cross-section analysis; AOI high-res imaging
failure_modes.recommended_action: Implement continuous reflow monitoring and alert system; add paste incoming inspection

failure_modes.process_function: Apply precise amount of solder paste to facilitate joint formation
failure_modes.failure_mode: Solder paste bridging (short between adjacent pads)
failure_modes.failure_effect_next_op: Electrical short detected during ICT; rework required; potential latent bridging if ICT false pass
failure_modes.failure_effect_end_user: If escaped: intermittent short, power drain, system resets; warranty return
failure_modes.failure_cause: Stencil aperture too large; solder paste too viscous; stencil clogged or worn
failure_modes.prevention_control: Stencil maintenance schedule (clean/replace per spec); paste viscosity control (monthly PoA check)
failure_modes.detection_control: AOI 100% coverage with high resolution; visual inspection per IPC-A-610
failure_modes.recommended_action: Implement stencil life tracking and automated replacement alerts

failure_modes.process_function: Verify electrical continuity, shorts, and parametric function before integration test
failure_modes.failure_mode: Test program false pass (missed defect due to test gap)
failure_modes.failure_effect_next_op: Defective unit advances to FCT and packing; defect escapes to customer
failure_modes.failure_effect_end_user: System malfunction in field; warranty return; safety risk if ESC not working
failure_modes.failure_cause: Test coverage incomplete; critical nets not probed; test vector insufficient
failure_modes.prevention_control: Test coverage audit (netlist verification); design for testability (DFT) review; vector validation
failure_modes.detection_control: FCT (Functional Test) as secondary check; cross-functional test review; live unit sampling
failure_modes.recommended_action: Complete test coverage audit and add 5 missing probe points; increase FCT coverage

failure_modes.process_function: Detect placement defects before reflow to prevent downstream issues
failure_modes.failure_effect_next_op: Misaligned component enters reflow; solder joint weak; may fail during or after assembly
failure_modes.failure_effect_end_user: Intermittent failure or latent defect escaping to customer
failure_modes.failure_cause: AOI camera drift; insufficient lighting; algorithm threshold too loose
failure_modes.prevention_control: Daily AOI calibration; lighting maintenance; algorithm tuning per pilot validation
failure_modes.detection_control: Backup visual inspection (sample 10%); cross-check with X-ray
failure_modes.recommended_action: Implement weekly AOI performance verification with golden samples

failure_modes.process_function: Verify end-to-end system functionality, load calibration and firmware
failure_modes.failure_mode: Firmware wrong version loaded (incorrect calibration; wrong feature set)
failure_modes.failure_effect_next_op: FCT may pass (if test doesn't validate firmware version); unit shipped with wrong config
failure_modes.failure_effect_end_user: Vehicle malfunction (wrong calibration = incorrect brake response); safety risk; recall likely
failure_modes.failure_cause: Programmer database error; manual bin selection mistake; build system misconfiguration
failure_modes.prevention_control: Automated firmware loader with version verification; build system w/ hash-based verification; barcode-driven BOM
failure_modes.detection_control: Bootloader checksum verification (mandatory pass); version logged to serial EEPROM; FCT version check
failure_modes.recommended_action: Ensure bootloader checksum is non-bypassable; add serial EEPROM version field read by test

failure_modes.process_function: Integrate PCB sub-assembly with mechanical components and connectors
failure_modes.failure_effect_next_op: High electrical impedance; intermittent communication loss during FCT or after shipment
failure_modes.failure_effect_end_user: Intermittent loss of ESC communication; vehicle safety risk
failure_modes.failure_cause: Connector tolerance stack-up; operator did not verify seating; fixture tolerance too loose
failure_modes.prevention_control: Assembly fixture with mechanical stop; insertion force test (go/no-go); operator training
failure_modes.detection_control: Connector insertion force gage (automated); continuity check during FCT
failure_modes.recommended_action: Implement automated insertion force gage in assembly fixture

failure_modes.process_function: Detect solder defects (cold joints, bridges, voids) before test
failure_modes.failure_mode: Solder bridge escaped AOI (false pass; algorithm missed fine bridging)
failure_modes.failure_effect_next_op: Bridge may or may not be detected by ICT (depends on net connectivity); risk of escape
failure_modes.failure_effect_end_user: If escaped: electrical short; power loss; system failure
failure_modes.failure_cause: AOI resolution insufficient for fine-pitch bridges; algorithm threshold loose; no X-ray backup
failure_modes.prevention_control: High-resolution AOI camera (enhanced lighting); algorithm tuned for fine-pitch detection; X-ray sampling
failure_modes.detection_control: X-ray inspection (AQL 1.0); ICT electrical test (shorts detection coverage >95%)
failure_modes.recommended_action: Upgrade AOI to 3D-capable system; increase X-ray sampling frequency

failure_modes.process_function: Protect PCB assembly from moisture and corrosion during field operation
failure_modes.failure_mode: Conformal coat applied to connector contacts (improper masking)
failure_modes.failure_effect_next_op: Connector may not mate fully; high contact resistance during assembly or in field
failure_modes.failure_effect_end_user: Intermittent connection; loss of system communication; warranty return
failure_modes.failure_cause: Masking tape incorrect or missing; operator technique inconsistent; spray technique variable
failure_modes.prevention_control: Standardized masking template; operator training video; assembly fixture with integral mask
failure_modes.detection_control: Visual inspection (sample 20%, trained operator); continuity test on connector pins during FCT
failure_modes.recommended_action: Implement automated masking fixture for conformal coat step

failure_modes.process_function: Ensure traceability, quality compliance, and safe shipment to customer
failure_modes.failure_mode: Serial number not applied or illegible
failure_modes.failure_effect_next_op: Loss of traceability; cannot link product to build lot for recall or warranty
failure_modes.failure_effect_end_user: If recall needed, unit cannot be identified; inability to verify firmware version
failure_modes.failure_cause: Label printer jam; insufficient label stock; label adhesive dry; barcode not scanned for verification
failure_modes.prevention_control: Printer maintenance schedule; label stock management; barcode scanner verification
failure_modes.detection_control: Label visual inspection (100%) before pack; barcode scanner validation
failure_modes.recommended_action: Add automatic barcode read verification before final pack

failure_modes.process_function: Place all SMT components in correct position and orientation
failure_modes.failure_mode: Wrong component placed (BOM error or feeder mix-up)
failure_modes.failure_effect_next_op: Component mismatch; may cause electrical malfunction or mechanical failure during reflow
failure_modes.failure_effect_end_user: Device malfunction or complete failure; warranty return
failure_modes.failure_cause: BOM data entry error; feeder labels wrong; operator distraction; component substitution without ECR
failure_modes.prevention_control: Barcode-driven feeder verification; BOM software with revision lock; operator double-check per checklist
failure_modes.detection_control: Component vision verification during placement; AOI 100% check; visual audit (spot check 5%)
failure_modes.recommended_action: Implement automated BOM loader with barcode feeder verification; restrict manual overrides

failure_modes.process_function: Verify electrical continuity, shorts, and parametric function before integration test
failure_modes.failure_mode: ICT probe misalignment (poor contact with test pad)
failure_modes.failure_effect_next_op: False open or erratic readings; unit may be rejected even if good, or pass despite defect
failure_modes.failure_effect_end_user: Defect escapes to FCT; intermittent failures in field
failure_modes.failure_cause: Fixture wear; probe tip corrosion; thermal drift; board registration error
failure_modes.prevention_control: Fixture maintenance schedule (replace probes every 10K cycles); probe tip cleaning; board registration check
failure_modes.detection_control: Continuity baseline check at fixture warmup; visual fixture inspection; test repeatability audit
failure_modes.recommended_action: Implement probe life tracking and automated replacement alerts in test handler

failure_modes.process_function: Verify PCB integrity and assembly readiness
failure_modes.failure_mode: Defective PCB accepted (missing incoming inspection or false pass)
failure_modes.failure_effect_next_op: Defect propagates through all downstream assembly steps; rework or scrap downstream
failure_modes.failure_effect_end_user: If defect reaches customer: potential field failure or safety issue
failure_modes.failure_cause: Incoming QC skipped due to time pressure; inspector fatigue; no visual standard
failure_modes.prevention_control: Mandatory incoming inspection procedure; visual standard per IPC-A-610; second-person verification for critical items
failure_modes.detection_control: AOI or X-ray sample (AQL 1.0) of incoming PCBs; electrical netlist continuity test
failure_modes.recommended_action: Formalize incoming PCB acceptance criteria and implement sampling plan per AQL 1.0
